chunks: When God, Mighty and Majestic, intended to create Adam (peace be upon him), He sent water upon the clay. Then He grabbed a handful and kneaded it. Then He separated it into two groups with His Hand. Then He scattered them, and behold, they were crawling.

Then He raised a fire for them and commanded the people of the left to enter it. So they went towards it but feared it and did not enter it. Then He commanded the people of the right to enter it. So they went and entered it. God, Majestic and Mighty, commanded the fire, so it became cool and safe for them.

When the people of the left saw that, they said, 'Our Lord, forgive us.' So He forgave them, then said to them, 'Enter it!' So they went and stood at it but did not enter it. So He returned them all to clay and created Adam (peace be upon him) from it.
And Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'So these ones will never be able to become from those ones, nor those ones to become from these ones.'
He said: 'They believe that the Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) was the first one to enter that fire.'
And that is His word, Majestic and Mighty: 'Say: If the Most Merciful had a son, I would be the first of the worshippers.'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الشِّمَالِ: People of the Left — those who refused the divine command despite forgiveness; spiritually deficient
key_terms.أَهْلُ الْيَمِينِ: People of the Right — those who obeyed God's command and entered the fire; spiritually elect
key_terms.الْعَابِدِينَ: The worshippers/those who submit — the Prophet as the foremost in devotion and obedience
key_terms.بَرْداً وَسَلَاماً: Cool and safe/peaceful — echoes Quran 21:69, where God commanded the fire to be cool and safe for Abraham (AS)

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kafi say about the pre-cosmic test of the people of the right and left before Adam's creation?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates a cosmological account of the creation of Adam (AS) from the Shia theological tradition. Before Adam was created from clay, God divided primordial humanity into two groups — the people of the right (ahl al-yamin), who obediently entered the fire when commanded, and the people of the left (ahl al-shimal), who refused despite being forgiven. This pre-cosmic test determined each soul's fundamental disposition. The Imam then applies Quran 43:81 to show that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) was the foremost among the obedient, being the first to enter the fire, establishing the theological doctrine that human nature and spiritual disposition are determined before birth.
